simple: Fortinet’s WAF for your own data center and cloud: FortiWeb hardware appliances (from 100 Mbps), virtual machines on common hypervisors and in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud, and containers. Two layers of protection: first FortiGuard signatures, IP reputation (botnets, anonymous proxies, infected hosts) and protocol validation, then machine learning on a model of your specific application — it tells a harmless user mistake from an attack and raises almost no false alarms. Blocks OWASP Top 10 attacks (SQL injection, XSS, request forgery, session hijacking), zero-day attacks, bots and scraping, password guessing, application-layer DoS and website defacement; scans uploaded files with antivirus. APIs: discovers APIs in traffic on its own and allows only requests that match the OpenAPI/XML/JSON schema. A built-in web application vulnerability scanner, and findings from third-party scanners (Acunetix, Qualys, AppScan and others) are automatically turned into rules (“virtual patches”). Sign-in via LDAP, RADIUS, SAML and RSA two-factor authentication; threat sharing with FortiGate and FortiSandbox. Enterprise bundle: FortiGuard web security, IP reputation and antivirus, the cloud sandbox for uploaded files, Credential Stuffing Defense, Threat Analytics, plus advanced bot protection, protection against malicious and unauthorized scripts in the visitor’s browser (Client-Side Security: Magecart, form-jacking, PCI DSS 4.0 requirements) and prevention of sensitive-data leaks in the site’s responses.
